findings: The primary record's vulnerability mechanism, introducer, immediate parent, direct fix, and BIC-only NOT_AI attribution independently reproduce from the advisory and clone.
The public OSS affected/fixed boundaries are reproducible: v3.2.10 and v4.0.3 retain the counter, while v3.2.11 and v4.0.4 contain the UUID backports.
Full release coverage remains fail-closed because the exact enterprise-line v3.1.15/v3.1.16 and v2.4.18 refs are not public; the vendor advisory is the only evidence for those boundaries.
remaining_gap: Exact source/ancestry membership for vendor-listed affected v3.1.15 and enterprise fixes v3.1.16 and v2.4.18 cannot be verified from the public clone or upstream refs.
